name: Boku to Iu Mono
source: The protagonist character has 'lived' alone and unfeeling as a conscience inhabiting random objects and animals for random times for as long as he can remember — but one day, he turns into the shape of a human boy. His life changes utterly when the human girl Sae decides to try to befriend him, naming him "Ao" for his deep blue eyes as he cannot speak. Every day, they have fun playing hide and seek — but one day, Sae stops coming...
translation:
主角从记事起便一直“独自生活”——作为寄宿在随机物品和动物体内、没有感情的意识，持续的时间也长短不一。可是有一天，他变成了一个人类男孩的模样。

当一个名叫纱江的人类女孩决定与他交朋友，并因他无法说话、拥有深蓝色的眼睛而给他取名“苍”时，他的生活彻底改变了。他们每天开心地玩捉迷藏，但有一天，纱江不再来了……
